content: FastAPI lifespan: @asynccontextmanager async def lifespan(app): startup code before yield, shutdown after; pass FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan). Replaces deprecated on_event startup/shutdown ('all lifespan or all events, not both'). Code before yield runs before the app accepts requests; after yield runs after it finishes handling requests. State via app.state. Mounted sub-apps do not receive lifespan events (main app only). Underlying mechanism is the ASGI Lifespan Protocol.
